name: speech-cpp
description: Umbrella port over the QVAC speech stack (tetherto/qvac-ext-lib-whisper.cpp): one source pin, per-engine features. This revision advances the shared source pin from 1cdde3bb to 5f181b9d. The window contains three changes: PR #155 makes the Parakeet Unified RNN-T 0.6B model work properly on Metal (the pinned ggml's Metal backend registers as 'MTL', so parakeet's backend_is_metal() never matched and the Apple-specific QKV-stacking gate silently stopped firing; verified on Apple M2 with CPU/Metal byte-identical transcripts and q8_0 RTF 0.028, plus new Metal GPU ctest fixtures and a macOS test-rnnt link fix); PR #152 validates the IndicConformer multilingual CTC on Metal (coverage only, no engine changes); PR #151 adds the MiniMax Music3 CPU engine to engines/audiogen. No ggml-speech bump required: the window is engine-side only and runs against ggml-speech 2026-08-17. speech-cpp[whisper] builds upstream whisper.cpp from third_party/whisper.cpp (CMake package `whisper`); speech-cpp[parakeet] builds the Parakeet ASR + Sortformer diarization engine from engines/parakeet under the qvac-parakeet namespace (find_package(qvac-parakeet) + qvac::parakeet); speech-cpp[tts] builds the TTS engine collection from engines/tts (find_package(tts-cpp) -- one library shipping Chatterbox, Supertonic, CosyVoice3, Parler-TTS, Audio8 and LavaSR); speech-cpp[audiogen] builds the ACE-Step music-generation engine from engines/audiogen (find_package(audiogen-cpp)). Upstream whisper.cpp's own bundled parakeet is explicitly NOT built or installed, so speech-cpp[whisper,parakeet] co-installs without the lib/parakeet.* file-ownership clash the standalone ports had. All engines link the single system ggml from the ggml-speech port; backend features fan out to the matching ggml-speech features. The default feature set is the whisper engine plus the platform's default GPU backend; consumers that want a different engine mix set default-features to false and pick explicitly. Replaced the standalone whisper-cpp, parakeet-cpp, tts-cpp and audiogen-cpp ports, which were removed once every consumer migrated.

audiogen.description: Build the audiogen engine (ACE-Step music generation) from engines/audiogen. CMake package: find_package(audiogen-cpp CONFIG) + audiogen-cpp::audiogen-cpp.

coreml.description: Parakeet only: enable the Apple Core ML (Neural Engine) encoder sidecar (presence-driven at runtime; falls back to the ggml encoder when the .mlmodelc sidecar is absent).

metal.description: Enable Metal GPU acceleration for all enabled engines (macOS / iOS, via ggml-speech[metal]).

opencl.description: Enable OpenCL GPU acceleration for all enabled engines (Android / Adreno, via ggml-speech[opencl]).

parakeet.description: Build the Parakeet engine (NVIDIA FastConformer ASR: CTC / TDT / EOU, plus Sortformer diarization) from engines/parakeet. CMake package: find_package(qvac-parakeet CONFIG) + qvac::parakeet.

tts.description: Build the TTS engine collection from engines/tts: Resemble Chatterbox (Turbo + Multilingual), Supertonic, Fun-CosyVoice3, Parler-TTS, Audio8 and LavaSR speech enhancement, as one library. CMake package: find_package(tts-cpp CONFIG) + tts-cpp::tts-cpp.

vulkan.description: Enable Vulkan GPU acceleration for all enabled engines (Linux / Windows / Android; Apple platforms use the metal feature instead, via ggml-speech[vulkan]).

whisper.description: Build the whisper engine from third_party/whisper.cpp (upstream whisper.cpp with the QVAC delta; upstream's bundled parakeet is gated off). CMake package: find_package(whisper CONFIG) + whisper::whisper.
